UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
NAAC ACCREDITED GRADE A++
UNIVERSITY CAMPUS, HAZRATBAL, SRINAGAR 190006, KASHMIR.
NOTICE
It is notified for information of all the candidates who have submitted their
application form in response to Advertisement Notice No. 04 of 2025, dated
22.05.2025 for the posts available in the Institute of Nursing and Paramedical
Sciences, South Campus, University of Kashmir that the Provisional list of applicants
along with their deficiencies, if any, is given in Annexure I and II to this Notice.
Further, if the applicants find any discrepancy regarding his/her status, he/she may
approach the office of the Recruitment Section of the University of Kashmir with
documentary proof within 07 days from the date of issuance of this Notice i.e.,
21.11.2025.
No claim after the last date for clearance of deficiencies shall be entertained.
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
Recruitment
No. F/Teaching-14/KU/25.
Dated; November 14th, 2025.
